confirmed_source_findings.finding: When the GDB connection is accepted, XRoar calls gdb_machine_signal(gip, MACHINE_SIGINT, 0). The signal handler stores the last signal; ack=0 suppresses the immediate stop-reply packet.

The read-only remote packet '?' calls send_last_signal, which formats the stored value as S%02x. Source therefore predicts S02 for the accepted-connection SIGINT and S05 for SIGTRAP. The packet handler does not continue, step, write guest memory, or request a memory dump.

The pinned installed formatter review supplied for this assignment shows stop reason/function/file fields but no signal-name field. That explains why the rendered stop line can omit SIGINT; it does not prove which signal the live stub returned.
